answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, a grove of sparse Merkle trees manages agent identities, requiring each to lock a pearl of staking collateral. Our structured, fourteen-phase sonnet of consensus enforces severe slashing penalties on duplicate states, proving negative expected attack utility and establishing a robust Nash equilibrium. By coupling recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments with verifiable delay, identity cloning becomes computationally infeasible, guaranteeing cryptographic finality.
